title: Fixed sun and driven ring
question: Drive R CW. Determine the motion of P (spin) and H (orbit) at the shown instant. Use the labeled contact views.

answer.explanation: Drive R CW. External mesh S/P (32/32 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. S held, P positive. Internal mesh P/R (32/96 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. P positive, R positive. S is locked to the frame. S held. 32 × (S − H) + 32 × (P − H) = 0. 32 × (P − H) − 96 × (R − H) = 0. The requested motion is CW / CW (in listed output order).

options.label: A
options.explanation: P must be CW. External mesh S/P (32/32 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. S held, P positive. Internal mesh P/R (32/96 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. P positive, R positive..

options.label: B
options.explanation: All requested motions agree with the contact constraints.

options.label: C
options.explanation: P must be CW. External mesh S/P (32/32 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. S held, P positive. Internal mesh P/R (32/96 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. P positive, R positive.. H must be CW. External mesh S/P (32/32 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. S held, P positive. Internal mesh P/R (32/96 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. P positive, R positive..

options.label: D
options.explanation: H must be CW. External mesh S/P (32/32 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. S held, P positive. Internal mesh P/R (32/96 teeth) uses spins relative to carrier H. P positive, R positive..
